rationale: The agent verified identity using full name plus zip, matched to a single user, then located the correct tablet order and provided the tool-sourced tracking number. Before any order-changing action, the agent explicitly confirmed the user’s intent and reason (for cancellations), then executed the correct tool calls. Returns were placed for the tablet and sneakers (delivered orders), with accurate messaging that refunds process upon return completion. Pending orders for the charger and the boots/kettle were cancelled after confirmation, with immediate refunds reflected by the tools and correctly relayed. No unsupported claims, no actions without confirmation, and all actions were on the authenticated user’s orders. The conversation followed policy end-to-end.
